text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...I gained weight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since becoming a Trainer, I've had so 
many more opportunities to eat with the 
girls that I've ended up gaining weight 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hellooo!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hellooo... wait, huh?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong, Trainer-san?! Why do you 
look so sad?! Are you not feeling well, or 
something?!?!?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Th-That's just way too saaaad--!!
choice_data_list:
No, it's just that I've gained a bit of 
weight...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, I see~. There are a lot of big 
eaters among Umamusume, after all.
choice_data_list: Maybe I should go on a diet...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ooh!? W-Well done!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As long as I am in the position of an 
instructor, I want to maintain a physique 
that serves as a role model whenever 
possible.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm zzooo movedddddd!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Trainer, you're incredible! 
Talk about crazy determinationーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I've decided! I'm gonna give it my all to 
help Trainer-san out!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Full poweeer!! I'm gonna support you with 
everything I've got, Trainer, so let's do 
our best together!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah!? Ticket-san at full power!? 
Th-this might be bad! Trainer might get 
broken into pieces!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
T-Ticket-san! Just be normal! Relax a 
little bit and just do your usual best, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hmm, you think so? Maybe it is...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, which do you prefer: 'All-out' or 
'Normal'!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm zzooo movedddddd~~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Got it, Traineeeer! I'll give it 
everything I've got to live up to your 
expectations!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Let's go running toward that 
setting sun!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
T-Ticket-saaann!? It's still noon, you 
know!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Good work, Trainer! ...Are you alright?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I trained "all out" with them. My body is 
utterly exhausted, unable to move a single 
step. I've collapsed face-first onto my 
desk with terrible manners.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet I'm still alive. It seems Winning 
Ticket held back for my sake.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOAAAAHHH! Just remembering you running 
your heart out, Trainer...! It's making 
the tears well up all over againnnn!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for your hard work. 
Here, have some water.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Post-workout meals are super important for 
a diet too, right!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Full power even for meals! I'll go all out 
picking the best low-calorie menu for you, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Still, my thinking back then was far too 
naive..."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yes! We have low-calorie salad chicken, 
tofu, natto, grilled fish, lots of wakame 
in miso soup, hanpen, and a huge serving 
of kamaboko!
choice_data_list: Too much, too much, too much, too much!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Still, if it's just this much, it 
really might be normal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That might be true for an Umamusume, but 
still!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much I eat, the amount just 
doesn't decrease at all!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I brought extra with all my 
might!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Gotta think about nutritional balance 
too! A heaping salad, boiled spinach, 
brown rice, stir-fried mushrooms and root 
veggies, soy milk, and yogurt!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Eat plenty and grow big with all your 
might!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Having eaten way too much, my body 
collapsed onto the floor."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Traineeeeeeeeeeeer!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume giving her 'all' is truly 
incredible. It served as a fresh reminder 
of that fact.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, it's best not to push yourself too 
hard.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: All right, I'll leave it in your hands!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Then to start things off... let's go for a 
30km run~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Come on! 30km is totally normal, totally!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOAAAAAHHHH! I'm so moooved, 
waaaahhhhhーー!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
A 30km run is just ordinary for you, 
Machitan!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Then let's just take it easy and do our 
best for 30 km~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: "Keep it up! You still have 10 km to go!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOAAAAAAAHHHH! The sight of you 
running your heart out, Trainer, gives me 
infinite couuurage!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: "Hang in there, fight on! Do your best!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Still, as I thought, somehow, I might 
want just a little bit more.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: My individuality!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Um! Let's do bunny hops for the remaining 
20 km!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Flump...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From the sheer intensity of the training, 
my body collapsed right onto the ground.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Waaaaahhhhhh...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even an "average" Umamusume is still truly 
amazing. It was a fresh reminder of that 
fact.
